blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Classes at all levels in public and private schools, as well as government work, in General Santos City will be suspended until further notice following the magnitude 5.6 earthquake off Davao Occidental. In an advisory, the General Santos government said the suspension would take effect Thursday, Oct. 8. A magnitude 5.6 earthquake earlier struck 28 kilometers northwest of Balut Island in Sarangani, Davao Occidental, at 4:07 p.m. The Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology initially reported that the tremor had a magnitude of 6.4 in its Earthquake Information No. 1.
